fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local reporting opposing a Florida state sales tax and criticizing Miami Herald publisher John S. Knight and the use of the Hoover Commission report to argue for cuts to government and civil service. Coverage includes Florida Governor Fuller Warren and state finances; calls for a referendum on Dade County’s extra-long school term; discussion of slot machines and gambling; a report on an Abe Aronovitz lawsuit seeking to block City of Miami payment of legal fees to Rep. George Smathers’ law firm; commentary on gun availability and violence in Miami’s Negro precinct and municipal court cases; notes on Jackson Memorial Hospital conditions; a comparison of Florida and Georgia marriage requirements; and items on employment trends and tourism promotion.
